_: Upcoming Pokémon TCG releases for the calendar page (lib/releases.ts). Only what an official source confirmed, with that source. Released sets come from the catalogs by themselves: an entry can go once its set is in the catalog. Kept up to date by the blog routine (docs/blog.md).

items.noteFr: 9 coffrets japonais (un par région, de Kanto à Paldea) : les 3 starters de la région, 2 boosters 30th CELEBRATION et un présentoir.
items.noteEn: 9 Japanese sets (one per region, Kanto to Paldea): the region's 3 starters, 2 30th CELEBRATION packs and a card stand.

items.noteFr: Tournois d'avant-première et coffrets Build & Battle en boutiques Play! Pokémon, deux semaines avant la sortie.
items.noteEn: Prerelease tournaments and Build & Battle Boxes at Play! Pokémon stores, two weeks before the release.

items.noteFr: Plus de 135 cartes, dont plus de 35 illustrations spéciales, avec Méga-Rayquaza-ex en tête. En France et dans le monde le même jour.
items.noteEn: Over 135 cards, including over 35 special illustrations, led by Mega Rayquaza ex. Worldwide on the same day.
